text: {"features":[{"name":"Security motivation","description":"How compellingly the letter explains why the applicant wants to do information security engineering specifically.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives only a generic reason for applying, with little explanation of why security engineering matters personally."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses genuine interest in security but mostly through broad statements of value or seriousness."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter offers a clear reason for wanting security engineering and links it to prior experience or preferred impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a thoughtful security philosophy or formative motivation that clearly connects to the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a memorable, convincing motivation for preventive security work that feels deeply aligned with this role."}]},{"name":"Automation mindset","description":"How clearly the letter frames the role as building automation that scales security work rather than doing security manually.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter treats the job mostly as generic software or security work and does not identify automation as the central problem."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions reducing manual work or toil but only in passing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly presents automation of security work as a major reason for applying."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how tooling can scale scarce security judgment or streamline work such as triage and variant analysis."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows a sharp, role-specific view of security automation as a leverage problem, explaining how systems can multiply expert capacity across many teams."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How strongly the letter shows enthusiasm for foundational systems whose benefits compound across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little sense of caring about foundational or organization-wide impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions scale or infrastructure briefly but without a developed platform perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly expresses interest in core systems whose benefits flow to many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter connects prior work or preferences to the multiplier effect of central platform engineering."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently frames impact in terms of inherited reliability, capacity, or protection across an entire organization."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter emphasizes helping other engineers follow security best practices through usable tools and defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter says little about serving developers or making secure behavior easier to adopt."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter briefly mentions helping teams or secure defaults without much substance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values making the secure path easier for other engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong empathy for developer workflows, such as preferring defaults, tooling, or close partnership over policy alone."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter articulates developer enablement as a core philosophy and shows nuanced understanding of how security tools succeed in real engineering environments."}]},{"name":"Company tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant's background and interests to Google and this exact team rather than to a generic security role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could be sent to almost any software or security role, with little evidence of why this specific team or company fits."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter names Google or the team but still reads mostly generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter ties the application to at least one distinct aspect of the posting, such as Google's scale, Core placement, or vulnerability-response focus."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter uses multiple role-specific details to connect prior work to this team's mandate."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter feels unmistakably written for this exact opening, integrating company context and job responsibilities throughout."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"How strongly the letter conveys a habit of building dependable systems with careful boundaries, correctness, and high standards.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little sign of a quality bar beyond general competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gestures at seriousness or reliability but without much detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values dependable systems, correctness, or careful engineering."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter reinforces rigor with concrete signals such as guardrails, typed and tested tooling, careful releases, or emphasis on correctness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes high standards a central theme and backs them with multiple concrete examples of disciplined engineering practice."}]},{"name":"Relevant experience","description":"How well the letter establishes sufficient production software experience in testing, maintaining, and launching systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter establishes only near-minimum relevant experience, such as a few years in industry and limited launched production systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows credible early-career production experience but with a narrower record of service ownership or launches."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents solid mid-level experience, with several years testing, maintaining, and launching production software."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong relevant breadth, combining multiple years with repeated ownership of launched services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates especially extensive relevant experience, with long-running production responsibility across many launched systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter shows readiness to design and implement Go back-end systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter merely lists Go among languages with no concrete role relevance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter states ongoing Go use but offers little evidence beyond language familiarity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go a substantial working language tied to backend or service work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter positions Go as a primary language and links it to concrete backend design or operation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go readiness unmistakable through repeated, specific evidence of primary ownership of backend systems, services, or public Go code."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter shows readiness to use Python for AI agents, automation, and tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python or gives no evidence of real use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions some Python use in tooling or scripting but without depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows Python as a meaningful working language for automation, internal tools, or prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes substantial production use of Python for services, analysis tooling, or agent layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as production-grade and central to recent work, emphasizing robust services or automation that other engineers depend on."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates direct experience designing agent-based systems with controlled autonomy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention agents or autonomous systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agentic work briefly but without architecture, boundaries, or implementation detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building agent-based systems in general terms, usually with Python agents and some supervision."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives a clear architecture for agentic systems, including autonomy paired with backend control mechanisms."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong judgment around bounded autonomy, with Python agents operating under explicit Go-enforced contracts, permissions, or auditing."}]},{"name":"AI production","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on experience applying AI or LLMs in production settings with real operational constraints.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention AI or ML work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI exposure or interest without clear production responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features but with limited detail on production constraints."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes applied AI in production with attention to reliability, hardening, or evaluation concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows mature AI experience by explaining how model-backed features were made dependable, evaluated, or safe in production."}]},{"name":"Security assessments","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on experience reviewing systems for vulnerabilities and validating mitigations.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies some security review work but with vague scope or responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states hands-on security assessment experience, such as reviews or threat modeling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured security assessments with concrete methods such as code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation follow-up."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial assessment maturity by framing security review as disciplined engineering work with documented findings, validation of fixes, and attacker-minded analysis."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"How strongly the letter shows direct experience automating intake, classification, routing, or handling of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security automation generally but without a clear vulnerability-report workflow example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that it automated intake or triage of vulnerability reports, with basic description of the improvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete vulnerability-handling pipeline with steps such as classification, routing, deduplication, or prioritization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep relevance by explaining how it turned a manual vulnerability queue into a largely automated system that materially reduced expert workload."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates fluency with data structures and algorithms in real engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention data structures or algorithms or offers only very general claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references algorithmic ability but with little concrete application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one believable example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong working fluency through specific technical examples on performance-critical or structurally complex problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates standout algorithmic depth with crisp, high-signal examples that turn previously hard or bottlenecked problems into tractable systems."}]},{"name":"Impact focus","description":"How clearly the letter communicates what changed because of the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mostly names tasks, technologies, or interests without saying what the work achieved."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies benefits but keeps them generic or purely qualitative."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter links key projects to recognizable improvements such as reduced toil or faster systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains concrete operational or team-level effects, such as returned expert time, eliminated bugs, or reduced bottlenecks."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently frames experience in high-leverage outcomes that make the scale of impact easy to judge."}]},{"name":"Example specificity","description":"How well the letter backs its claims with concrete technical examples rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on abstract claims about skills or fit, with few concrete examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes at least one specific example but keeps most claims general."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter uses several concrete examples or anecdotes to support key claims."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is packed with specific, role-relevant examples that make the applicant's experience easy to picture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers highly concrete evidence throughout, with crisp examples tied directly to the role's tasks and constraints."}]},{"name":"Security depth","description":"How strongly the letter adds extra security credibility through certifications, competitions, or other hands-on signals beyond ordinary job experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no credential, competition, or comparable signal beyond ordinary job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter adds only a faint extra signal of security interest, but nothing that strongly validates hands-on depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes one clear supplementary signal such as a baseline certification or recurring capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong extra security credibility through a demanding certification, strong competition results, or sustained offensive practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines multiple high-credibility signals or presents one especially rigorous signal in a way that strongly reinforces hands-on security depth."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"How strongly the letter shows contribution to or maintenance of public technical projects used beyond the applicant's immediate team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention any open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions occasional contributions or upstream patches in passing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows recurring open-source contribution or maintenance of a small project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes meaningful maintenance responsibility or regular upstream contribution to tools that others use."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial open-source leadership, such as maintaining an actively used project or library with reviews, releases, and community interaction."}]},{"name":"Personal initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical building outside assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention any personal project or self-directed technical work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small side project but without much technical ambition or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows steady personal initiative through a modest but completed technical project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a personally chosen project that tackles nontrivial engineering problems or keeps relevant skills sharp."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses a substantial self-directed build to demonstrate curiosity, rigor, and appetite for hard systems problems beyond assigned work."}]},{"name":"Writing clarity","description":"How clearly the letter presents a coherent, easy-to-follow case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter is hard to follow, overly list-like, or weakly organized, making the fit argument feel fragmented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter is understandable but choppy, repetitive, or only loosely structured."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is clear and competently organized, with a logical progression of points."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is smooth and cohesive, guiding the reader through motivation, evidence, and fit with little friction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally coherent and persuasive, with a memorable structure or narrative that strengthens every claim."}]},{"name":"Mechanical polish","description":"How free the letter is from spelling, typing, and grammar errors that distract from professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, typing, or usage errors are distracting and materially undercut professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Noticeable mechanical errors appear throughout, though the text remains readable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Some errors are present but they do not dominate the reading experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is mechanically clean with only rare minor mistakes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is essentially error-free and polished to a professional standard."}]}]}
